'''Subtext mining''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] corporation managed by the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] species which manufactured the [[M-2 mining probe droid]]. In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], Subtext sold an M-2 to the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. However, the droid had been sabotaged by an unknown party, and as the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] investigated a lode of [[Cortosis/Legends|Cortosis]] ore on [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]], it deliberately ignited a pocket of [[lethane]] gas, resulting in Tenebrous' death.<ref name="Darth P" />

As retribution, Plagueis kidnapped a group of Subtext's executives and marooned them in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] for one standard year. Though he did not ultimately discover the culprit, his interrogation of the executives led him to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after one of their number attempted to make amends by informing him of a vast [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] source on the planet that Subtext was investigating. There Plagueis would discover a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], his future apprentice Darth Sidious. After the executives' disappearance was noted by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Pax Teem]], Plagueis had his [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] [[Sun Guard]] retrieve the group, execute them and dump their bodies outside Subtext's [[Subtext Mining Corporate Headquarters|offices]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Darth P" />
